svg.title: Reported TikTok citation growth across AI search platforms
svg.desc: Semrush reported TikTok citation growth from January to August 2026 of 224 percent in Google AI Overviews, 146 percent in Google AI Mode, 313 percent in ChatGPT and 294 percent in Gemini.
svg.text: TikTok citations grew across four AI platforms
Semrush reported change, January to August 2026
Source: Semrush, US prompt dataset, January to August 2026. Growth rates are study-specific, not global market benchmarks.
